meta.title: Motion graphics
meta.description: Creates motion graphics end to end: a spoken script, drawn SVG visuals, an optional composed music bed, and a HyperFrames HTML-to-MP4 composition that is checked frame by frame and opened in a Studio preview. Ask for an explainer, a lesson clip, a title card, a data clip or a social video; the agent writes the script, plans and draws each scene, runs the checks, sends the preview link, and renders MP4 only when you ask. The HyperFrames contract and CLI ship inside the plugin and every helper is plain Node, so another machine needs only Node.js 22+: FFmpeg is checked before the first render or snapshot and installed on the machine once you agree, and the first CLI run downloads HyperFrames and a headless Chrome into the project's .hf-cache folder. Turning the plugin off removes the three skills; project folders, caches and renders stay where they are.
